Project Folder

Create a project folder in preparation for development.
To create a project called MyGame, create a /src/MyGame/ folder.
Copy the following folders and files from the /src/goki2/ folder to the /src/MyGame/ folder.
components
debug
modules
system
krkr_autopath.ary
startup.tjs
run.bat

These are the minimum required folders.
Create a folder here to store your scenario scripts (for example, a scene folder) and add a line to krkr_autopath.ary to add the scene.
You can add as many folders as you like. (Don't forget to add a line to krkr_autopath.ary.)

All modules are loaded by default, so edit /src/MyGame/system/construct.gs and remove (or comment out) any modules you don't need.
To configure your project, edit /src/MyGame/system/config.gs to suit your project.

The following script, which configures KAG-compatible scripts, is loaded by default.

/src/MyGame/KAGCompatible.gs:
@que unshift storage=KAGCompatibleDefault.gs
@que unshift storage=KAGCompatibleBookmark.gs
@que unshift storage=KAGCompatibleImage.gs
@que unshift storage=KAGCompatibleMessage.gs
@que unshift storage=KAGCompatibleRightClick.gs
@que unshift storage=KAGCompatibleSnapshot.gs
@que unshift storage=KAGCompatibleSound.gs
@que unshift storage=KAGCompatibleVideo.gs
For example, if you don't want to load ModBookmarks, delete (or comment out) the following line:
;@que unshift storage=KAGCompatibleBookmark.gs

That's it.

Personally, I recommend committing the Avalanches environment directly to a Subversion repository and developing it.
This makes it easier to create patches using the /tools/make/ tool.
